extracted.stage: Estate administration; property awaiting sale, IHT deadline pending
extracted.summary: A solicitor acting for executors of a £1,310,500 illiquid St Albans estate enquires about borrowing £72,500 for professional fees and inheritance tax ahead of an 11 November HMRC deadline.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry regarding funding for the administration of this estate. We have recorded the key details you provided: an estate valued at approximately £1,310,500, funding sought of £72,500, and an HMRC deadline of 11 November. To progress our review, we would be grateful for confirmation of the executors' details and their authority, a breakdown of the estate's assets and liabilities, the grant of probate position, details of the property and its marketing status, and the proposed source of repayment. Once we have these, a member of our team will be in touch to discuss next steps.
